text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: tracing exports failing to Honeycomb EU ingestion (5xxs). Paging oncall. Root at 2026-05-12T22:15:34Z (thread_ts=1845091234).

sahil (oncall-sre): I'm awake, pulling logs now. Any user-visible errors or metrics alerts?

maria (observability): metrics/health checks fine. Only distributed tracing affected. We see a hard gap for spans starting ~22:12 UTC across services. No increase in 5xxs from customer-facing APIs.

alex (eng-infra): otel-collector logs show repeated failures:
```
2026-05-12T22:13:01Z ERROR exporter/otlptrace: send failed status=502 body="{\"error\":\"bad gateway\"}"
2026-05-12T22:13:02Z WARN connection: TLS handshake reset by peer api.honeycomb.io:443
```
Connection resets and 502s look upstream.

sahil (oncall-sre): mitigation plan: 1) flip emergency exporter to New Relic to restore span visibility, 2) enable local persistent queueing on honeycomb exporter to avoid dropping, 3) post status update. I'll perform the NR flip as a canary.

maria (observability): agreed. NR will ingest basic spans; sampling tags may differ. We'll accept that for short-term. I'll prepare a dashboard note explaining sampling differences.

alex (eng-infra): applying change to k8s collector env for cluster-a first:
```
kubectl -n observability set env deploy/otel-collector OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otlp.newrelic.com:4317
kubectl -n observability set env deploy/otel-collector OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="api-key=$NR_INSIGHTS_KEY"
```
Rolling sequentially. Will push to cluster-b in ~5m if cluster-a looks good.

maria (observability): also enabling queueing on the honeycomb exporter to buffer until vendor recovers. Config snippet:
```
exporters:
  honeycomb:
    api_key: ${HONEYCOMB_KEY}
    transmission:
      queue_enabled: true
      max_batch_size: 512
      retry_on_failure: true
```
This will increase local disk usage slightly but reduces potential drop.

ops-bot: Opened vendor ticket HNY-2026-77 with Honeycomb (support@honeycomb.io). Included log samples and curl repro. Ticket is acknowledged; ETA 30-60m.

jess (support): Do we want a public status page message? If so, short and non-technical.

sahil (oncall-sre): yes. "Investigating partial interruption of trace exports to Honeycomb affecting visibility; no impact to core product availability. Engineers are working and short-term mitigation in place." Jess, please post and ping enterprise contacts.

jess (support): Posted to status.redwood.com and DM'd enterprise tracing customers. Email template appended to ticket.

alex (eng-infra): cluster-a flipped to New Relic; I see spans in NR UI within ~30-40s. Cluster-b rollout started. Honeycomb test POST still returns 502s from our cluster:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.honeycomb.io/v1/traces -H "X-Honeycomb-Team: $KEY" -d '{}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

maria (observability): NR ingestion is working. We lose some Honeycomb-specific metadata (dataset naming, tags) but we have continuity for tracing. I'll map key fields for post-incident analysis.

sahil (oncall-sre): root cause triage: Alex, check recent deploys, certs, keys. Maria, check for increased exporter latencies or resource pressure.

alex (eng-infra): no config or credential changes in last 72h. TLS handshakes reset after negotiation — points to vendor-side gateway trouble or their EU region ingress.

maria (observability): exporter metrics show send_error_count spiking, exported_spans dropping to zero for honeycomb target. No collector OOMs. I agree vendor-side.

ops-bot: Honeycomb responded on HNY-2026-77: "Investigating intermittent HTTP 502s in EU ingestion cluster; engineering engaged. Next update in 30m."

sahil (oncall-sre): ok the mitigation stands. Keep a single oncall point (me) for 30m, then Maria will take over monitoring & vendor liaison. If Honeycomb escalates or customer incidents come in, we re-page.

jess (support): Support messages sent to customers with tracing hooks. No immediate replies. Will escalate any incoming reports to this channel.

maria (observability): note for postmortem: capture exporter metrics (exporter/otlptrace/sent_spans, exporter/otlptrace/send_errors), queue stats, and sample span payloads (with PII redacted). We'll compute total span loss delta per service and sampling impact.

sahil (oncall-sre): handoff plan: I'll remain active for 30 more minutes to finish rollouts. Maria takes over at +30. If Honeycomb announces resolution before handoff, I'll validate end-to-end and coordinate reversion to honeycomb with a canary. Reversion criteria: honeycomb POSTs return 200s for 3 consecutive minutes and exporter error rate ~0.

maria (observability): ack. I'll prepare a short runbook entry for reverting exporters: 1) switch env back to HNY endpoint, 2) monitor for increased send_errors, 3) revert again to NR if instability recurs. Add a 10-minute canary window.

incident-bot: Annotated incident: type=third_party_vendor, vendor=Honeycomb, impact=traces_missing/delayed, mitigation=nr_fallback + local_queueing, incident_id=1845091234. Add notes to incident tracker and link to HNY-2026-77.

sahil (oncall-sre): thanks team. Leaving applied k8s diffs and logs in the incident tracker. Maria, please summarize any customer-facing impact we should keep in status updates during your shift.

maria (observability): will do. Ill monitor NR dashboards, Honeycomb ticket, and collector exporter metrics. If vendor posts "resolved" we'll validate with curl + 3min steady state before initiating revert.

-- thread marked for follow-up: capture span-loss by service and sampling delta for post-incident report --
